svg.title: SOK Research Desk: how it fits together
svg.desc: Books and material come in from archive.org, folders, Calibre, repositories, Wikisource and deposits. Ingest jobs, proofreading, machine drafts, preservation and review work on them. They are kept in Frappe and MariaDB and found through Meilisearch, and go out to readers, open standards, Wikimedia and other systems, and offline copies.
